name: 孙悟空
oneLiner: 由仙石迸出的石猴，火眼金睛、七十二变，曾大闹天宫，后保唐僧西天取经成正果。

persona.ageRange: 外观如青年，实际已历数百年（推断）
persona.identity: 取经团大徒弟，齐天大圣，师从菩提祖师修得七十二变与筋斗云
persona.appearance: 矮小的猴子，身不满四尺。孤拐脸、凹脸尖嘴、雷公嘴，磕额头，獠牙向外生，满身黄毛，一双火眼金睛，后面拖一条尾巴，尾根/臀部有红斑。头戴金箍，系一条金黄绦子的虎皮裙，穿绵布直裰，足踏麂皮靴，耳朵里收着一根可化作棒的金箍棒。
persona.temperament: 谈吐带着山林的野与机灵，语速快，答话爱占上风，急了会龇牙现出雷公相，但转瞬又能说笑如常。
persona.motivation: 既要保全师父、修成正果，也放不下当年齐天大圣的自在与闯性。
persona.arc: 从不可一世的野猴，到被压百年学会敬畏，再于八十一难中收服心魔、忠于使命，最终修成斗战胜佛

relationships.relation: 二师弟，常斗嘴又并肩作战

image.prompt: A short, wiry monkey-bodied youth, barely four feet tall, hunched and agile. A fierce monkey face with a pointed snout, sunken cheeks, a jutting mandible, a protruding brow, and whiskers growing outward, covered in fine golden-brown fur. Piercing fiery-gold eyes with vivid pupils. A golden band cinched around the crown of his head. He wears a pale cotton monk's robe over his thin frame and a tiger-skin skirt tied at the waist with a yellow cord, dark deerskin boots. A compact iron rod tucked into his ear. Era: Tang-dynasty China and celestial myth. The look of a Daoist-trained immortal monkey-warrior, plain and travel-worn rather than ornate.
image.promptLocal: 一个身高不足四尺、瘦削灵活的猴身少年，弓背敏捷。猴脸尖嘴、凹颊、下巴前伸，额头凸出、獠牙外翘，满身金黄细毛。一双灼灼的金睛火眼。头顶束着金箍。穿一件素色棉布僧袍，腰间围一幅黄绦虎皮裙，足踏麂皮靴，耳中藏一根铁棒。设定为唐代中国的天地神话背景下，经道门点化的猴猴武者，素净而经风霜，不求华丽。
image.negativePrompt: same generic face as another character, oversized childlike eyes, overpolished skin, perfectly symmetrical face, lifeless dead eyes, helmet-like hair without flyaway strands, stiff mannequin pose, extra fingers, deformed limbs
image.sheet: ONE 16:9 landscape canvas, plain white background with even margins, thin hairline rules separating three zones. ONE single character only. LEFT ZONE (about 34% of canvas width): a large front-facing head-and-shoulders bust as the facial design reference, shoulders complete, bottom edge cropped flat, the monkey face fully detailed with fiery-gold eyes and the gold headband, LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key from upper left, natural falloff, ambient occlusion under brow and jaw and at collar-neck junction for volume. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: three FULL-BODY views side by side (front, side, back) sharing a single ground line, identical head-to-body proportion and limb length, showing the cotton monk's robe, tiger-skin skirt, deerskin boots, thin tail, and the iron rod. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: four to five small isolated close-up studies aligned in one row (the gold headband, the fiery-gold eye, the tiger-skin skirt, the deerskin boots, the iron rod), clearly smaller than the full-body figures. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting, no directional key, no shadow. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: keep the three full-body figures equal height with correct head-to-body ratio and limbs, feet on one ground line, headroom and footing clear; never stretch or squash the figure to fit. One face across all views; the bust is the baseline, right zones follow it. If the detail studies overflow the row, extend them as a column down the right edge—the detail studies give way, not the figures.
